Test only. These are proposed pixel-level fixes for three [[Reflections Gold (remaster changes)|Reflections Gold remastered]] card images, from Bill's review of 30 October 2026. The live card images, the card pages and the remaster changes article are unchanged. Each proposed image keeps the size and format of the current remaster, and only the pixels in the changed area differ.

== Looking To The Future ==
{| class="wikitable"
! Original scan !! Current remaster !! Proposed fix
|-
| [[File:RG-C1-Looking-To-The-Future.jpg|220px]] || [[File:RG-GEMP-Looking-To-The-Future.png|220px]] || [[File:TEST Reflections Gold remaster fix - Looking To The Future.png|220px]]
|}
[[File:TEST Reflections Gold remaster fix - Looking To The Future zoom.png|none|900px]]
'''Change:''' the lore now reads "behind them, it was time for", with the comma the original card has. The comma is a real comma glyph in the same lore font and size, taken from [[Bad Lifters And Faulty Wings (Reflections Gold Remastered)|Bad Lifters And Faulty Wings]] ("there,"). "it was time for" moved 4 px right with its own background, so no letter was redrawn.

The current remaster also has a darker, flatter rectangle behind "City and Hoth behind them", left over from an earlier paste. The fix rebuilds the silver plate in that area from empty plate lower in the same lore box, blends it into the brightness around it, and keeps the remaster's own letters on top. The zoom shows the whole first lore line.

[[File:TEST Reflections Gold remaster fix - Strike Blocked zoom.png|none|600px]]
'''Change:''' one credit coin instead of three, as on the original card. The top two coins were replaced with the matching pixels from [[Quite A Mercenary (Reflections Gold Remastered)|Quite A Mercenary]], a one-credit card on the same frame template, so the frame and the remaining coin are identical to a native one-coin card.
